jobs.title: Private Assets Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Lombard Odier Investment Managers (“LOIM”) is the asset management business of the Lombard Odier Group. In order to strengthen our Private Assets department, we are looking for a Geneva based:

Investment Analyst- Private Assets

As an Investment Analyst, you will work closely with Investment Managers and broader team members across all stages of the private equity investment cycle, contributing to the sourcing, assessment, and monitoring of private asset opportunities

YOUR ROLE

• Maintain and update the private assets fund opportunity pipeline

• Analyse new private equity fund investments, co‑investments/directs, industry trends, and market dynamics

• Perform detailed due diligence on investment opportunities, including qualitative and quantitative analysis

• Prepare investment memoranda, due diligence documentation, and internal committee materials

• Monitor and report on existing fund investments, providing in‑depth performance insights

• Support the preparation of marketing materials for LOIM private equity strategies and products

• Develop sales pitches, presentations, and other materials for internal and external stakeholders

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in business, economics, finance, or engineering

• Prior professional experience in Private Equity, Corporate Finance, or Investment Banking is essential

• Native-level proficiency in English; professional working proficiency in French

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with excellent attention to detail

• Proactive, innovative, and results‑driven mindset

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Lombard Odier Investment Managers (“LOIM”) è l’attività di gestione patrimoniale del Gruppo Lombard Odier. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro dipartimento di beni privati, stiamo cercando una base di Ginevra: Investimenti Analisti - Beni privati In qualità di Investment Analyst, lavorerai a stretto contatto con Investment Manager e membri del team più ampi in tutte le fasi del ciclo di investimento azionario privato, contribuendo all'apprezzamento, alla valutazione e al monitoraggio delle opportunità di asset privati Il tuo!
• Mantenere e aggiornare l'opportunitÃ del fondo patrimoniale privato
• Analizzare nuovi investimenti privati, co-investimenti/direzioni, tendenze del settore e dinamiche di mercato
• Eseguire la dovuta diligenza dettagliata sulle opportunità di investimento, tra cui l'analisi qualitativa e quantitativa
• Preparare la memoranda degli investimenti, la documentazione di due diligence e i materiali dei comitati interni
• Monitorare e segnalare gli investimenti dei fondi esistenti, fornendo approfondimenti sulle prestazioni
• Sostenere la preparazione di materiali di marketing per LOIM strategie private equity e prodotti
• Sviluppare campi di vendita, presentazioni e altri materiali per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni Il tuo progetto
• Laurea magistrale, idealmente in economia, economia, finanza o ingegneria
• Prima esperienza professionale in Private Equity, Corporate Finance o Investment Banking è essenziale
• Competenza di livello nativo in inglese; competenza professionale in francese
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con ottima attenzione ai dettagli
• Set mentale proattivo, innovativo e guidato dai risultati
• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente dinamico e veloce e gestire più priorità
• Competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione eccezionali, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 225 Jahre langen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Lombard Odier Investment Manager ("LOIM") ist das Asset Management-Geschäft der Lombard Odier Gruppe. Um unsere Private Assets-Abteilung zu stärken, suchen wir einen Genfer Standort: Investment Analyst- Private Assets Als Investment Analyst arbeiten Sie eng mit Investment Managern und weiteren Teammitgliedern in allen Phasen des Private-Equity-Investitionszyklus zusammen und tragen zur Beschaffung, Bewertung und Überwachung von privaten Asset-Möglichkeiten bei IHRE ROLLE
• Erhaltung und Aktualisierung der Möglichkeiten des privaten Fonds
• Neue Private Equity-Fonds-Investitionen, Co‐Investments/Direkte, Branchentrends und Marktdynamik analysieren
• Durchführung detaillierter Due Diligence auf Investitionsmöglichkeiten, einschließlich qualitativer und quantitativer Analysen
• Vorbereitung von Investitionsgedächtnis, Due Diligence Dokumentation und interne Ausschussmaterialien
• Überwachen und Bericht über bestehende Fondsinvestitionen, die umfassende Leistungseinsichten bieten
• Unterstützung der Vorbereitung von Marketingmaterialien für LOIM Private Equity Strategien und Produkte
• Entwicklung von Verkaufsstellen, Präsentationen und anderen Materialien für interne und externe Akteure IHRE PROFILE
• Masterstudium, ideal in Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder Ingenieurwesen
• Vorherige Berufserfahrung in Private Equity, Corporate Finance oder Investment Banking ist unerlässlich
• Native-Level-Proficiency in englischer Sprache; professionelle Arbeitsfähigkeit auf Französisch
• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit ausgezeichneter Liebe zum Detail
• Proaktive, innovative und ergebnisorientierte Denkweise
• Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld zu leben und mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten
• Herausragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ zu arbeiten Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass der Aufbau von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und dass wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unsere Geschäftsstrategie einbetten. Es ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich unseren Teams anzuschließen. Alle Anwendungen werden im strengsten Vertrauen behandelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 225 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Lombard Odier Investment Managers est une entreprise de gestion d'actifs du groupe Lombard Odier. Afin de renforcer notre département des actifs privés, nous recherchons une base Genève : Analyste des investissements - Actifs privés En tant qu'analyste des investissements, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires des investissements et les membres de l'équipe à toutes les étapes du cycle d'investissement en capital-investissement, contribuant ainsi à l'approvisionnement, à l'évaluation et au suivi des possibilités d'acquisition d'actifs privés Votre rôle
• Maintenir et mettre à jour le portefeuille d'opportunités de fonds d'actifs privés
• Analyser les nouveaux investissements des fonds de capital-investissement, les co-investissements/directs, les tendances de l'industrie et la dynamique du marché
• Effectuer une diligence raisonnable détaillée sur les possibilités d'investissement, y compris une analyse qualitative et quantitative
• Préparer des mémorandums d'investissement, de la documentation sur la diligence raisonnable et du matériel de comité interne
• Surveiller les investissements existants et en rendre compte, en fournissant des informations approfondies sur le rendement
• Soutenir la préparation de matériel de marketing pour les stratégies et produits de fonds propres LOIM
• Développer des emplacements de vente, des présentations et d'autres matériaux pour les parties prenantes internes et externes VOTRE PROFIL
• Maîtrise, idéalement en affaires, économie, finance ou ingénierie
• Une expérience professionnelle préalable en Private Equity, Corporate Finance ou Investment Banking est essentielle
• Compétences des autochtones en anglais; compétences professionnelles en français
• Fortes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une excellente attention aux détails
• Une mentalité proactive, innovante et axée sur les résultats
• Capacité de prospérer dans un environnement dynamique et rapide et de gérer de multiples priorités
• Compétences interpersonnelles et de communication exceptionnelles, avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et en collaboration L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. C'est un moment passionnant de rejoindre nos équipes. Toutes les demandes seront traitées avec la plus grande confiance.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

The Group Tax Department contributes to the value creation of the Group by controlling its tax. Joining the Group Tax Department as a Tax Intern in our Geneva headquarters, you will :

• Gain understanding of the daily work and organization of a Corporate Tax Affairs Department at the head office of a leading multinational group

• Obtain valuable professional experience whilst supporting the members of the Group Tax Department

YOUR ROLE

As an intern within our Group Tax Department, you will have the opportunity to participate in current projects and new initiatives. The role mainly consists in assisting all the team members in dealing with Swiss and International direct and indirect tax subjects.

Working closely with the entire tax team you may have the opportunity to perform the following tasks:

• Contribute actively to the internal domestic and international tax watch

• Conduct tax studies and legal researches to address concerns raised by the various stakeholders

• Participate in updating the transfer pricing documentation and tax disclosure/compliance obligations

• Assist in the preparation of tax computations and compliance work

• Support the team on indirect tax projects

• Assist when dealing with tax administrations’ requests

• Ad-hoc project work

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong interest for corporate taxation

• Master’s degree obtained (or in progress) in tax law, accounting or finance

• Fluent in French and English is necessary

• Good knowledge of Microsoft office suite (especially Excel and Word)

• Ambitious, enthusiastic, with a team oriented spirit and curious to learn through a first experience within a leading multinational group. You enjoy working closely and interact with colleagues within an international environment

• Available per July or September 2026

• Domicile in Switzerland

jobs.title: Développeur Full-stack IA/ML & Reporting Designer
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Développeur Full-stack IA/ML & Reporting Designer

Rejoignez le département Technology & Operations de Lombard Odier au sein de l'équipe Content and Communications, responsable de la plateforme de gestion de contenu et de la production/distribution des documents clients et partenaires.

Nous recherchons un développeur Full-stack IA/ML et Reporting Designer afin de participer au développement de notre nouvelle plateforme technologique bancaire qui est également mise à disposition d’autres banques privées suisses et européennes.

Intégré(e) aux équipes produits, vous apporterez une expertise à l’intersection des LLM et de l’ingénierie logicielle appliquées à la finance : recherche documentaire augmentée (RAG), orchestration et optimisation d’inférence (on‑prem/cloud), intégration des modèles dans les parcours front‑office, et automatisation du reporting en production. Vous industrialiserez la génération et la personnalisation des documents via la suite Quadient Inspire (templates, composants, workflows et publication), en garantissant la qualité, la traçabilité et l’auditabilité de bout en bout. Vous évoluerez au sein d’une organisation agile, proche des utilisateurs finaux et du métier, au contact de technologies modernes et éprouvées.

VOTRE MISSION

• Contribuer aux développements de nos applications de gestion de contenu et de la production/distribution des documents.

• Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, les problèmes à résoudre ainsi que les contraintes d’ordre technique.

• Proposer et implémenter des solutions technologiques adaptées et tenant compte des aspects précités.

VOTRE PROFIL

• Master en informatique avec spécialisation en IA, Machine Learning et Data analytics suivi dans l'une des universités polytechnique suisse.

• Première expérience professionnelle ou stage significatif dans le développement applicatif, le reporting ou les outils documentaires.

• Computer Vision : Maîtrise des LLM/VLM appliqués aux documents (RAG, extraction visuelle, compréhension de mise en page).

• Expérience en détection d’anomalies documentaires (contrôles visuels, cohérence sémantique, règles métier).

• Maîtrise des langages de programmation Java et Python

• Expérience en LLM engineering : fine‑tuning, quantization, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), et orchestration (LlamaIndex).

• Connaissance du framework de développement d’application web Angular

• Expérience conteneurs (Dockers / Kubernetes) et DevOps

• Expérience pratique des méthodologies Agile, Scrum est un plus

• Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais

• Vous avez une excellente communication à l’écrit comme à l’oral

• Vous avez un bon esprit d’analyse et une bonne capacité d'abstraction afin d’identifier et expliciter le problème à résoudre avant de penser aux solutions

• Vous êtes capable de donner du feedback constructif et prêt à en recevoir

• Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie

• Domicilié en Suisse ou disposé à vous y établir

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core valu

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinnovato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati del mondo, che gestisce vicino a CHF 300 trilioni e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. "Rethink Everything" è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Sviluppatore completo IA/ML & Reporting Designer Partecipa al dipartimento Tecnologia e Operazioni di Lombard Odier nel team Content and Communications, responsabile della piattaforma di gestione dei contenuti e della produzione/distribuzione dei documenti cliente e partner. Siamo alla ricerca di uno sviluppatore IA/ML e Reporting Designer Full-Stack per contribuire a sviluppare la nostra nuova piattaforma di tecnologia bancaria, che è disponibile anche ad altre banche private svizzere ed europee. Integrato nei team di prodotto, si porterà competenze all'intersezione di LLM e ingegneria del software applicata alla finanza: una maggiore ricerca documentaria (RAG), l'orchestrazione e l'ottimizzazione dell'inferenza (on-prem/cloud), l'integrazione dei modelli nei viaggi di front-office e l'automazione del reporting in produzione. L'industrializzazione e la personalizzazione dei documenti attraverso la suite Quadient Inspire (templati, componenti, flussi di lavoro e pubblicazione), garantendo qualità, tracciabilità e verificabilità end-to-end. Si evolverà all'interno di un'organizzazione agile, vicino agli utenti finali e la professione, con il contatto di tecnologie moderne e provate. LA TUA MISSIONE
• Contribuire allo sviluppo delle nostre applicazioni di gestione dei contenuti e alla produzione/distribuzione di documenti.
• Comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, i problemi da risolvere e i vincoli tecnici.
• Proporre e realizzare soluzioni tecnologiche adeguate tenendo conto degli aspetti sopra menzionati. Il tuo progetto
• Master in informatica con specializzazione in AI, Machine Learning e analisi dei dati seguiti in una delle università politecniche svizzere.
• Prima esperienza professionale o stage significativi nello sviluppo delle applicazioni, nel reporting o negli strumenti documentari.
• Computer Vision: Mastery of LLM/VLM applicata ai documenti (RAG, estrazione visiva, comprensione del layout della pagina).
• Esperienza nel rilevamento di anomalie documentarie (controlli visivi, consistenza semantica, regole aziendali).
• Controllo dei linguaggi di programmazione Java e Python
• Esperienza di ingegneria LLM: fine tuning, quantizzazione, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), e orchestrazione (LlamaIndex).
• Conoscenza del quadro di sviluppo delle applicazioni web angolari
• Esperienza di contenitore (Dockers / Kubernetes) e DevOps
• Esperienza pratica di metodologie Agile, Scrum è un plus
• Conoscenza attuale della lingua francese e inglese
• Hai una comunicazione eccellente sia per iscritto che per orale
• Hai una buona mente per l'analisi e una buona capacità di astrazione per identificare e spiegare il problema da risolvere prima di pensare a soluzioni
• Siete in grado di dare feedback costruttivi e pronti a riceverlo
• Hai una grande autonomia
• Casa in Svizzera o disposta a stabilirsi in Svizzera La nostra casa

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

With over 250 professionals, our Investment Solutions department is responsible for providing sophisticated and highly customized investment proposals to our private clients.

Equities & Derivatives Execution Trader (80-100%)

Mission:

• Equities & Derivatives Trade Execution: Execute, monitor, and optimize the bank’s equity and derivative client flows across global markets, ensuring consistent best execution in line with applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance frameworks. The ideal candidate will have a strong expertise in future and option strategies).

• Late Shift: Take part in cross asset execution coverage until the U.S. market close (each execution trader participating in a limited number of late shifts per month)

• Technology & Automation: Actively Contribute to the enhancement of electronic trading strategies, leveraging trading data and analytics to help design implement, and scale new automation process

• Counterparty Interaction: Maintain strong relationships with brokers and market makers to optimize execution and access liquidity

Your Profile:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field

• Experience: Minimum of 3 years in derivatives and equity trading

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Bloomberg, TradeWeb and order management systems

• Familiarity with algorithmic and electronic trading solutions is highly advantageous

• Analytical & Execution Skills: Strong market analysis capabilities, sound judgment under pressure, and ability to handle high trade volumes with precision and efficiency

• Communication : Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with senior management, counterparties, and technology teams

• Teamwork: Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively with investment professionals and clients

• Project skills: Proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of initiative and active participation in cross-functional projects

• Languages: Fluent in both English and French

• Service minded, accurate, autonomous

• Must be a resident of Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Der ideale Kandidat wird eine starke Expertise in Zukunft und Optionsstrategien haben.
• Späteres Schalten: Nehmen Sie an der Deckung der Vermögensübertragungen teil, bis der US-Markt geschlossen ist (jeder ausführende Händler, der an einer begrenzten Anzahl von späten Schichten pro Monat beteiligt ist)

• Kommunikation: Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, klar mit Senior Management, Gegenparteien und Technologieteams zu kommunizieren
• Teamwork: Teamorientiertes Denken mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Investment-Profis und Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten
• Projektfähigkeiten: Proaktiv und detailorientiert, mit einem starken Initiativgefühl und aktiver Beteiligung an funktionsübergreifenden Projekten
• Sprachen: fließend in Englisch und Französisch

Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Le candidat idéal aura une solide expertise dans les stratégies futures et les options).
• Late Shift: Participez à la couverture d'exécution croisée des actifs jusqu'à la fermeture du marché américain (chaque opérateur d'exécution participant à un nombre limité de quarts tardifs par mois)

• Interaction des contreparties: maintenir des relations solides avec les courtiers et les responsables du marché pour optimiser l'exécution et accéder à la liquidité Votre profil:
• Éducation: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en finance, économie ou domaine connexe
• Expérience: minimum de 3 ans dans les transactions sur produits dérivés et sur actions
• Compétences techniques: maîtrise des systèmes Bloomberg, TradeWeb et de gestion des commandes
• La connaissance des solutions de trading algorithmique et électronique est très avantageuse
• Compétences d'analyse et d'exécution: Fortes capacités d'analyse du marché, jugement solide sous pression, et capacité à gérer des volumes commerciaux élevés avec précision et efficacité
• Communication : Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles avec la capacité de communiquer clairement avec les cadres supérieurs, les contreparties et les équipes technologiques
• Travail d'équipe: esprit d'équipe avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les professionnels de l'investissement et les clients
• Compétences en matière de projets: proactif et axé sur les détails, avec un fort sens de l'initiative et une participation active à des projets interfonctionnels
• Langues : Anglais et français
• Service pensé, précis, autonome
• Doit être résident de Suisse ou disposé à déménager L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos succès et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans notre stratégie d'affaires. jobs.title: Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%)

Within the IT Operations unit, our team (16 people between Luxembourg and Geneva) is dedicated to integrate new business applications into our ecosystem according to the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure and Dev). Our team makes our core app evolution easier and smoother, without compromising quality.

YOUR ROLE

• Manage the release management process to reduce operational risk in prod and test environments:

• Coordinate planned changes between dev and production teams

• Facilitate the Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings

• Efficiently integrate new business applications into the ecosystem from design to implementation in various environments (Dev/Test/UAT and prod)

• Coordinate and execute technical tasks based on the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure/provider and Dev)

• Identify and mitigate risks, technical issues, and dependencies across the project

• Collaborate with the Provider (Third-party Package) on Lombard Odier technical requirements

• Develop the project's reference document in collaboration with Dev

• Estimate the workload of IT tasks during the project

• Implement continuous improvement using the Problem Management process to reduce downtime for business applications- Internal stakeholders: Development, Service Management (Incident/Problem Management), DBA, Network, Citrix/Virtualization, Tooling, IT Security, IT Risk.

• External stakeholders: Software and Service Vendors, Business Process Outsourcing Clients (Banks who are using our IT Platform and services)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master in IT or equivalent

• Good command of development languages and linked application servers: JAVA, JBOSS, C++

• Good command of CI/CD tooling: Openshift, Kubernetes, DevOps principles

• Good command of production tooling: FTP transferts, schedulers

• Previous experience of the Banking sector will be an asset

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, with good interpersonal skills and team spirit. Ready to propose enhancements and participate to continuous improvment initiatives.

• Fluent in English and French

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

• Service Now

• Serena

• ArgoCd

• NetScaler

• Java

• Apache/IIS

• Openshift

• Kubernetes

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

With more than 200 professionals, our Investment Solutions department is responsible for providing sophisticated and customised investment proposals to our private clients. In this context, we are seeking an experienced Investment Advisor to join our wealth management team in Geneva.

YOUR ROLE

• Actively manage, monitor and review advisory portfolios for South Europe and Latin America regions.

• Offer clients and bankers portfolio advisory services, in accordance to Lombard Odier’s view as well as clients’ constraints and preferences.

• Prepare and present in a compelling manner investment proposals, reports and presentations to clients and prospects.

• Contribute to the development of the investment offering and the client book through strong commercial support to bankers.

• Master the investment solutions offering of the bank, in order to advise the bankers and clients in the most adapted manner.

• Maintain a high degree of knowledge on financial markets, traditional and alternative assets, investment strategy and portfolio management as well as market trends, particularly in the regions of coverage.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bank or university education and/or recognised diploma in investment (CFA an asset).

• Minimum 10 years’ proven track record in advisory and/or portfolio management, ideally in the regions of coverage.

• Excellent customer presentation, client service and communication skills. Strong commercial awareness.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, flexibility and autonomy, ability to acquire and share skills.

• Team player, with ability to acquire and share skills, build trust and collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients.

• Open and dynamic personality with ability to take decisions, flexibility and autonomy.

• Ability to work efficiently under pressure and evolving market conditions.

• Good knowledge of Bloomberg, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Fluent in English and French. Spanish would be an asset.

• Swiss domicile.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

To further strengthen our Private Assets department, we are looking for a Geneva based

Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%)

In this role, you will contribute to the operational, financial, and analytical oversight of our Private Assets portfolios.

YOUR ROLE

• Ensure the administrative follow-up of Private Assets investment funds and mandates

• Collect, verify, and process subscription forms for new investments

• Prepare and release capital call and distribution notices

• Support the preparation of AUM and NNM reporting

• Participate in the production of track records and performance analytics

• Prepare the quarterly valuations of Private Assets investment funds

• Support product launches from an operational perspectives

• Participate in the preparation and issuance of client invoices

• Contribute to IT system enhancements through user acceptance testing and validation

• Coordinate with Fund Accountants to ensure accurate bookkeeping and data integrity

• Prepare regular reports and dashboards for Private Assets Investment Managers

• Support the preparation of updates for Senior Management and Boards

• Perform accounting and controlling activities for Private Assets products and mandates

• Support internal and external audit requests and provide active assistance to the team

• Liaise with departments across the Group, LOIM, and the Private Bank (e.g., Finance, Operations)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in economics, finance, or a related discipline

• 3–5 years of experience in controlling within Private Assets

• Strong command of English (spoken and written) and good knowledge of French

• Excellent Excel skills; solid knowledge of eFront; exposure to Alteryx or Tableau is a plus

• Rigorous, detail‑oriented, and able to manage priorities and meet deadlines

• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Pour renforcer davantage notre département des biens privés, nous recherchons une Contrôleur des investissements privés (80-100%) Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la surveillance opérationnelle, financière et analytique de nos portefeuilles d'actifs privés. Votre rôle
• Assurer le suivi administratif des fonds et mandats d'investissement privés
• Recueillir, vérifier et traiter les formulaires de souscription pour les nouveaux investissements
• Préparer et publier les avis d'appel et de distribution
• Appuyer la préparation de rapports sur l'AUM et la NNM
• Participer à la production d'enregistrements de piste et d'analyses de performance
• Préparer les évaluations trimestrielles des fonds d'investissement privés
• Soutenir les lancements de produits sous l'angle opérationnel
• Participer à la préparation et à la publication des factures des clients;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration des systèmes informatiques par des tests d'acceptation et de validation des utilisateurs
• Coordonner avec les experts-comptables pour assurer l'exactitude de la comptabilité et de l'intégrité des données
• Préparer régulièrement des rapports et des tableaux de bord à l'intention des gestionnaires d'investissements privés
• Appuyer la préparation de mises à jour pour les cadres supérieurs et les conseils d'administration
• Exécuter des activités de comptabilité et de contrôle pour les produits et les mandats d'actifs privés
• Appuyer les demandes d'audit interne et externe et fournir une assistance active à l'équipe
• Assurer la liaison avec les départements du Groupe, de la LOIM et de la Banque privée (par exemple, Finances, Opérations) VOTRE PROFIL
• Maîtrise, idéalement en économie, finance ou discipline connexe
• 3-5 ans d'expérience dans le contrôle des actifs privés
• Forte maîtrise de l'anglais (parlé et écrit) et bonne connaissance du français

• Régulière, détaillée et capable de gérer les priorités et de respecter les délais
• Joueur d'équipe solide avec un esprit de collaboration et d'excellentes compétences en communication L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. jobs.title: Head of Spain
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Our Southern Europe & Latin America (SELA) region is seeking a Head of Spain to lead and develop our Swiss-based teams serving Spanish clients.
This strategic leadership role will offer significant scope to shape the business, drive growth, and contribute to broader regional initiatives within a highly international environment.

YOUR ROLE

• Lead and develop the Spain teams based in Geneva and Zurich, ensuring strong performance and engagement within the bank’s strategy.

• Define and execute a strategic business plan, including commercial initiatives, market positioning, and revenue growth.

• Coach and develop Private Bankers while attracting and retaining top talent.

• Drive business performance, including team and individual KPIs, revenue growth, and Net New Money generation.

• Ensure excellence in risk management and compliance, maintaining the highest standards.

• Act as a member of the SELA Executive Committee, contributing to broader regional strategy and decision-making.

• Strengthen market intelligence on Spain and identify opportunities for innovation and growth.

• Design and coordinate tailored offerings and initiatives for Spanish clients across locations and regional markets

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience within the banking industry.

• Proven leadership capabilities, with potential for wider scope and evolution. Ability to inspire, develop, and scale teams.

• Strong commercial mindset with a track record of growing client relationships and revenues.

• Ability to demonstrate personal initiative, ownership, accountability and entrepreneurship.

• Ability to attract, recruit and develop talented and skilled professionals.

• Strategic thinker with the capacity to operate both hands-on and at a broader leadership level.

• Fluent written and spoken Spanish and English, French and other relevant languages an asset.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. La nostra regione dell'Europa meridionale e dell'America Latina (SELA) sta cercando un capo della Spagna per guidare e sviluppare le nostre squadre svizzere che servono clienti spagnoli. Questo ruolo di leadership strategica offrirà uno scopo significativo per modellare il business, promuovere la crescita e contribuire a iniziative regionali più ampie all'interno di un ambiente altamente internazionale. Il tuo!
• Guidare e sviluppare le squadre spagnole con sede a Ginevra e Zurigo, garantendo prestazioni e impegno forti all’interno della strategia della banca.
• Definire ed eseguire un piano aziendale strategico, tra cui iniziative commerciali, posizionamento del mercato e crescita dei ricavi.
• Allenare e sviluppare Private Bankers attrarre e mantenere il talento superiore.
• Guidare le prestazioni aziendali, tra cui team e singoli KPI, crescita dei ricavi e generazione Net New Money.
• Assicurare l'eccellenza nella gestione e nella conformità dei rischi, mantenendo i più elevati standard.
• Atto come membro del Comitato Esecutivo SELA, contribuendo ad una strategia regionale più ampia e al processo decisionale.
• Rafforzare l'intelligenza di mercato sulla Spagna e individuare le opportunità di innovazione e crescita.
• Progettare e coordinare offerte e iniziative su misura per clienti spagnoli in luoghi e mercati regionali Il tuo progetto
• Esperienza rilevante minima di 10 anni nell’industria bancaria.
• Prove capacità di leadership, con il potenziale per una maggiore portata ed evoluzione. Capacità di ispirare, sviluppare e scalare le squadre.
• Forte mentalità commerciale con un track record di crescenti relazioni e ricavi dei clienti.
• Capacità di dimostrare l'iniziativa personale, la proprietà, la responsabilità e l'imprenditorialità.
• Capacità di attrarre, reclutare e sviluppare professionisti di talento e qualificati.
• Pensatore strategico con la capacità di operare sia hands-on che a livello di leadership più ampio.
• Fluente scritto e parlato spagnolo e inglese, francese e altre lingue rilevanti un bene. Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

• Security Master File: Opening and updating information in the Security Masterfile database on financial instruments held by our clients.

• Reconciliation: Reconcile cash, securities, listed derivatives, precious metals, etc. Comparing transactions and balances of the Bank’s books with our network of cash counterparties, securities depositories, Transfer Agents etc.

YOUR ROLE

• Assist team members in daily tasks

• Work on specific project and requests, while learning from senior peers

YOUR PROFILE

• A keen interest in the Banking sector, especially in Middle Office / Operations domains

• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Senior Trust Relationship Manager (80-100%)
Private Clients – Wealth Planning

Lombard Odier Trust (Bermuda) Limited is seeking a Senior Trust Relationship Manager (STRM) to oversee a portfolio of international private client structures. This role combines client relationship management, trust administration oversight, and team coordination within a multicultural environment, ensuring high fiduciary, regulatory, and governance standards.

YOUR ROLE

Client Relationship & Trust Administration

• Act as primary contact for a portfolio of international private client structures.

• Manage relationships with clients, advisors, family offices, and internal stakeholders across jurisdictions.

• Oversee daily administration activities (distributions, transactions, resolutions, bank relationships, reviews, regulatory reporting such as CRS/FATCA).

• Ensure compliance with legal, tax, and regulatory requirements.

• Review financial statements, maintain accurate records, and monitor client billing.

• Support business development, onboarding, and risk assessment processes.

Governance & Operations

• Contribute to reporting, audits, risk monitoring, and fiduciary strategy.

• Maintain and enhance policies, procedures, and internal controls.

• Monitor KPIs, fee governance, and operational efficiency improvements.

• Collaborate with stakeholders and represent the business in committees and industry forums.

Senior & Team Responsibilities

• Provide technical guidance and oversight on complex trust matters.

• Support work allocation, team coordination, and service delivery quality.

• Identify and manage operational and fiduciary risks.

• Mentor team members and promote best practices, strong compliance culture, and consistent service standards.

YOUR PROFILE

• TEP qualification (or equivalent) with 10+ years’ experience in trust administration or fiduciary services.

• Strong exposure to UHNW private clients and private banking environment.

• Proven ability to manage complex international client relationships with diplomacy and sound judgment.

• Solid understanding of fiduciary structures, risk management, and regulatory frameworks.

• Strong organisational, communication, and commercial skills.

• Fluent in English.

Additional skills (minimum three)

• French proficiency

• Wealth/tax planning or corporate secretary experience

• Knowledge of Viewpoint or similar systems

• Exposure to audit, compliance, or governance committees

• Experience in process improvement or transformation initiatives

• Strong cultural awareness and international exposure

• Expertise in governance, dispute resolution, or presentation of complex topics

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Group Risk Assurance Controls Manager (80–100%)

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and strategic Risk Assurance Controls Manager to join the Operational Risk Management department in Switzerland. This role sits within the second line of defense and carries full ownership of the Group’s risk assurance and control testing framework, including the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of assurance plans.
The successful candidate will lead and develop control testing activities across the organization, provide independent oversight over first line risk and control frameworks, and deliver high-impact insights to senior management and governance bodies. The role includes direct line management responsibility and requires a strong ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

YOUR ROLE
Leadership & Ownership

• Own, design, and continuously enhance the Group-wide risk assurance control testing framework and annual assurance plan

• Lead and develop a small team (1 FTE), providing coaching, priority setting, and performance oversight

• Act as a subject matter expert and key point of contact for control assurance topics across the organization

• Drive consistency, quality, and efficiency in control testing methodologies and outputs

Control Testing Strategy & Execution

• Define, implement, and execute a risk-based control testing strategy aligned with regulatory expectations and internal priorities

• Oversee and perform periodic and ad-hoc control testing across business units and processes

• Ensure comprehensive coverage of key risks and controls, with a forward-looking and thematic approach

• Challenge the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identifying systemic weaknesses and emerging risks

• Ensure high-quality documentation of testing procedures, results, and conclusions

Second Line of Defense Oversight

• Provide independent oversight and challenge of first line risk management and control frameworks

• Assess the adequacy of Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and other first line control activities

• Engage with senior stakeholders to provide expert opinions on control effectiveness and risk exposure

• Collaborate with Internal Audit and other assurance functions to ensure alignment and avoid duplication

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

• Deliver clear, concise, and impactful reporting to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies

• Escalate key issues, trends, and systemic control weaknesses in a timely manner

• Provide actionable recommendations to strengthen the control environment and mitigate risks

• Act as a trusted advisor to business and control functions on control design and assurance matters

Issue Management & Follow-up

• Oversee the tracking and validation of remediation actions for identified control deficiencies

• Ensure timely closure of issues and appropriate root cause analysis

• Monitor recurring themes and drive improvements at a structural level

An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Group Risk Assurance Controls Manager (80–100%) We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and strategic Risk Assurance Controls Manager to join the Operational Risk Management department in Switzerland. This role sits within the second line of defense and carries full ownership of the Group’s risk assurance and control testing framework, including the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of assurance plans. The successful candidate will lead and develop control testing activities across the organization, provide independent oversight over first line risk and control frameworks, and deliver high-impact insights to senior management and governance bodies. The role includes direct line management responsibility and requires a strong ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. YOUR ROLE Leadership & Ownership
• Own, design, and continuously enhance the Group-wide risk assurance control testing framework and annual assurance plan

• Drive consistency, quality, and efficiency in control testing methodologies and outputs Control Testing Strategy & Execution

• Oversee and perform periodic and ad-hoc control testing across business units and processes
• Ensure comprehensive coverage of key risks and controls, with a forward-looking and thematic approach
• Challenge the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identifying systemic weaknesses and emerging risks
• Ensure high-quality documentation of testing procedures, results, and conclusions Second Line of Defense Oversight
• Provide independent oversight and challenge of first line risk management and control frameworks
• Assess the adequacy of Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and other first line control activities
• Engage with senior stakeholders to provide expert opinions on control effectiveness and risk exposure

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Stagiaire - Database Administration & Observability Specialist (Foglight / Elastic)

Dans le cadre du renforcement de la supervision des bases de données et du déploiement d’une plateforme d’observabilité centralisée, l’équipe DBA recherche un(e) stagiaire pour accompagner un projet stratégique autour de Foglight (monitoring bases de données) et de son intégration avec la plateforme Elastic utilisée à l’échelle de la banque.

Ce stage offre une exposition concrète à des environnements bancaires critiques , des technologies de supervision modernes et à un projet transverse impliquant plusieurs équipes IT (DBA, Systèmes, Sécurité, Observabilité).

Le/la stagiaire accompagnera l’équipe DBA dans le suivi, la coordination, le déploiement et la documentation du projet Foglight, ainsi que dans son intégration avec la plateforme d’observabilité Elastic .

Le stage combine :

• Pilotage fonctionnel de projet,

• Mise en œuvre technique encadrée,

• Communication et documentation,

• Découverte des bonnes pratiques de supervision en milieu bancaire.

VOTRE MISSION

1. Pilotage et coordination du projet Foglight

• Participer au suivi du planning global Foglight & Elastic .

• Organiser et coordonner les réunions avec :

• Les référents des différentes technologies DB au sein de l’équipe DBA,

• Les équipes Systèmes, Sécurité et Observabilité.

• Préparer les comptes-rendus , tableaux de suivi et reportings d’avancement.

• Contribuer à la circulation fluide de l’information entre les équipes.

2. Implémentation de la supervision Foglight

Accompagné(e) par les experts DBA, le/la stagiaire participera à :

• L’ajout des environnements Test / UAT / Production dans Foglight.

• La validation des métriques collectées pour les différents SGBD.

• La création de dashboards de santé haut niveau par technologie.

• La définition et le paramétrage des alertes pertinentes .

• L’intégration avec ServiceNow pour l’ouverture automatique d’incidents.

• L’intégration avec Elastic pour la remontée des métriques de supervision.

3. Documentation et structuration

• Rédiger et maintenir la documentation projet .

• Produire la documentation fonctionnelle de l’intégration Foglight → Elastic .

• Créer des guides utilisateurs et procédures internes destinés aux équipes IT.

4. Support à la formation interne

• Préparer des supports de formation (présentations, guides).

• Contribuer à l’organisation et au bon déroulement de sessions de formation internes sur Foglight et Elastic.

5. Communication et visibilité du projet

• Préparer les communications internes officielles liées au projet.

• Mettre à jour les espaces Confluence / Teams .

• Participer à la communication autour des sujets d’ observabilité au sein de la banque.

Missions spécifiques – Observabilité Elastic

• Recueillir et formaliser les besoins en métriques, alertes et dashboards Elastic.

• Décrire fonctionnellement les flux de données Foglight → Elastic .

• Coordonner les échanges entre l’équipe DBA et l’équipe O

Dieses Praktikum bietet einen konkreten Einblick in kritische Bankumgebungen, moderne Überwachungstechnologien und ein funktionsübergreifendes Projekt, an dem mehrere IT-Teams beteiligt sind (DBA, Systeme, Sicherheit, Observability). • Beaufsichtigte technische Umsetzung,
• Kommunikation und Dokumentation,
• Entdeckung guter Aufsichtspraktiken im Bankenumfeld. IHRE AUFGABE 1. Management und Koordination des Foglight-Projekts

• Den Vertretern der verschiedenen DB-Technologien innerhalb des DBA-Teams,
• Den System-, Sicherheits- und Observability-Teams.
• Erstellen Sie Berichte, Überwachungstabellen und Fortschrittsberichte.
• Tragen Sie zum reibungslosen Informationsfluss zwischen den Teams bei. 2. Implementierung der Foglight-Überwachung. Begleitet von DBA-Experten wird der Praktikant an Folgendem teilnehmen:
• Der Hinzufügung von Test-/UAT-/Produktionsumgebungen in Foglight.
• Validierung der für die verschiedenen DBMS gesammelten Metriken.
• Die Erstellung von Gesundheits-Dashboards auf hoher Ebene mithilfe von Technologie.
• Definition und Konfiguration relevanter Alarme.
• Integration mit ServiceNow zum automatischen Öffnen von Vorfällen.
• Integration mit Elastic für die Berichterstellung von Überwachungsmetriken. 3. Dokumentation und Strukturierung
• Projektdokumentation erstellen und pflegen.
• Erstellen Sie eine funktionale Dokumentation für die Foglight → Elastic-Integration.
• Erstellen Sie Benutzerhandbücher und interne Verfahren für IT-Teams. 4. Interne Schulungsunterstützung
• Bereiten Sie Schulungsmaterialien vor (Präsentationen, Leitfäden).
• Tragen Sie zur Organisation und zum reibungslosen Ablauf interner Schulungssitzungen zu Foglight und Elastic bei. 5. Projektkommunikation und Sichtbarkeit
• Bereiten Sie offizielle interne Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit dem Projekt vor.
• Aktualisieren Sie Confluence/Teams-Bereiche.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Kommunikation zu Observability-Fragen innerhalb der Bank. Spezifische Missionen – Elastic Observability
• Erfassen und formalisieren Sie den Bedarf an Elastic-Metriken, -Warnungen und -Dashboards.
• Funktionale Beschreibung von Foglight → elastischen Datenflüssen.
• Koordinieren Sie den Austausch zwischen dem DBA-Team und dem O-Team

jobs.title: SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%)

Within our IT Department, you will join a team of experts responsible for the evolution of our financial ecosystem. In a Private Banking environment where data precision and availability are critical, you will play a key role within a scope covering accounting, business intelligence, planning and consolidation, and expense management. Your mission will be threefold:

• Ensure operational continuity through second and third-level support,

• Steer the evolution of the platform in close collaboration with the SAP product owner, and Finance stakeholders,

• Contribute to cross-functional project delivery.

You will also participate to our technological transition toward next-generation solutions (S/4HANA).

YOUR ROLE

Product Evolution & Project Delivery:

• Gather and analyze business requirements from Finance and Controlling teams.

• Design functional solutions and write specifications

• Contribute to BPC planning model evolution and BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud reporting developments

• S/4HANA Transformation: Actively contribute to S/4 Hana conversion projects and new onboarding projects.

• Manage end-to-end delivery of change requests and projects (scoping, testing, training, go-live).

• Configure SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) and CO modules.

• Ensure all changes comply with internal change management and audit frameworks.

Application support & maintenance:

• Provide Level 2 / Level 3 functional and technical support for SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC and Concur.

• Investigate, diagnose and resolve incidents within agreed SLAs; escalate to SAP when required.

• Monitor batch jobs, interfaces and data flows; ensure system health and data integrity.

• Manage transports, patches and corrections across the landscape.

• Maintain functional and technical documentation up to date after every change.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 7 years of hands-on SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) experience in a complex, regulated environment (functional & technical expertise)

• Proven track record in both support/run activities and project mode

• Good command of SAP BW reporting, BPC planning & consolidation, and SAP Concur configuration and integration with SAP FI

• Knowledge or experience on S/4HANA architecture and migration concepts will be appreciated

• Solid understanding of financial accounting processes: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset management, bank reconciliation

• Familiarity with private banking operational flows (client accounting, fees, treasury, regulatory reporting) is a plus

• Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate complex functional requirements into technical solutions

• Excellent communication skills – able to present to both technical and business audiences

• Rigorous, autonomous and structured; comfortable managing several tasks and priorities simultaneously

• Collaborative team player with a service-oriented attitude

• Full proficiency in French and English

• Residence

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%) All'interno del nostro reparto IT, si unirà a un team di esperti responsabili dell'evoluzione del nostro ecosistema finanziario. In un ambiente Private Banking dove la precisione e la disponibilità dei dati sono fondamentali, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave all'interno di un ambito di contabilità, business intelligence, pianificazione e consolidamento e gestione delle spese. La vostra missione sarà triplice:
• Assicurare la continuità operativa attraverso il supporto di secondo e terzo livello,
• Promuovere l'evoluzione della piattaforma in stretta collaborazione con il proprietario del prodotto SAP e con gli stakeholder Finance,
• Contribuire alla consegna del progetto interfunzionale. Parteciperai anche alla nostra transizione tecnologica verso soluzioni di nuova generazione (S/4HANA). Il tuo! Prodotto Evolution & Project Delivery:
• Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti aziendali dai team Finance e Controlling.
• Progettazione di soluzioni funzionali e specifiche di scrittura
• Contribuire all'evoluzione del modello di pianificazione BPC e a BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud
• S/4HANA Transformation: contribuisce attivamente ai progetti di conversione S/4 Hana e ai nuovi progetti di imbarco.
• Gestire la consegna end-to-end di richieste di cambiamento e progetti (scoping, test, formazione, go-live).
• Configurare i moduli SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) e CO.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le modifiche siano conformi ai quadri interni di gestione dei cambiamenti e audit. Supporto per applicazioni e manutenzione:
• Fornire il supporto tecnico e funzionale al livello 3 per SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC e Concur.
• Indagare, diagnosticare e risolvere gli incidenti all'interno di SLA concordati; escalare a SAP quando necessario.
• Monitorare lavori in batch, interfacce e flussi di dati; garantire la salute del sistema e l'integrità dei dati.
• Gestire trasporti, patch e correzioni attraverso il paesaggio.
• Mantenere documentazione funzionale e tecnica fino ad oggi dopo ogni cambiamento. Il tuo progetto
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato (esperienza funzionale e tecnica)
• Provato record di traccia in attività di supporto/esecuzione e modalità progetto
• Buon comando del reporting SAP BW, della pianificazione e del consolidamento BPC e della configurazione e integrazione SAP Concur con SAP FI
• La conoscenza o l'esperienza sui concetti di architettura e migrazione S/4HANA saranno apprezzati
• Comprensione solida dei processi contabili finanziari: registro generale, contabilità pagabile/ricevibile, gestione patrimoniale, riconciliazione bancaria
• La familiarità con i flussi operativi bancari privati (contabilità clienti, commissioni, tesoreria, reporting normativo) è un plus
• Forte mentalità analitica con capacità di tradurre complessi requisiti funzionali in soluzioni tecniche
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione – in grado di presentare al pubblico sia tecnico che commerciale
• Rigoroso, autonomo e strutturato; gestione confortevole di più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente
• Giocatore di squadra collaborativo con un atteggiamento orientato al servizio
• Competenza completa in francese e inglese
• Residence
