jobs.title: Test Architect (80–100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Test Architect (80–100%)

We are looking for an experienced and passionate Test Architect to join our Technical Architecture team and shape how quality is engineered across our organization.
You will drive the adoption of modern Quality Engineering practices across the full Software Delivery Life Cycle and lead our Test Factory initiative. Beyond technical expertise, you will act as a strategic enabler and influencer, fostering a strong culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
You will work in a modern technology environment including:

You will work in a modern and evolving technology landscape, including:

• Frameworks: Spring Boot, Quarkus, Angular

• Platforms: OpenShift, Kafka

• Innovation: AI-related R&D

YOUR ROLE

Test Strategy & Quality Engineering

• Define and evolve the enterprise testing strategy aligned with Test Factory objectives

• Design scalable test architectures and automation frameworks

• Establish standards, best practices, and quality gates

• Integrate testing into CI/CD/CT pipelines for continuous quality

Coaching, Mentoring & Enablement

• Coach and mentor development and QA teams

• Promote shift-left and shared ownership of quality

• Lead trainings, workshops, and communities of practice

• Provide clear documentation and actionable guidelines

• Adapt practices to team context and maturity

Collaboration & Communication

• Collaborate with Engineers, QA, Architects, and Product Owners

• Build relationships based on trust and collaboration

• Communicate complex topics clearly and effectively

• Drive continuous improvement and engineering excellence

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

• Experience as Test Architect, QA Architect, or senior QE leader

• Strong knowledge of testing across the full lifecycle

• Experience in Agile and DevOps environments

• Hands-on with frameworks: Cucumber, Gatling, Karate, JMeter, Playwright or similar

• Experience with tools: Tosca, qTest, XRay or similar

• Development experience in Java (Spring/Quarkus) and/or JS/TS

• Experience with CI/CD integration and cloud-native environments

• Exposure to functional, API, performance, and smoke testing

• Ability to influence, coach, and inspire

• Strong communication and adaptability

• Empathy and passion for enabling others

• Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

• Collaborative and comfortable in multicultural environments

• Fluent in English and French

• Based in Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric

Senior IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / File Transfer / Monitoring (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform (renewal of our platforms), we are looking for production engineers familiar with technologies around file transfer, scheduling and alerting, who will be able to support us throughout this transformation, while at the same time supporting the current installed base.

Management of an application pool within the IT Operations department (Technologies and Operations unit), in a team of 7 employees operating from Geneva.

YOUR MISSION

• Responsible for implementing business requests on our alerting/scheduling/file transfer platforms

• Qualification of requests, detailed documentation of specs

• Actively participate and make proposals for the evolution of the platforms

• Actively participate and make proposals to improve and automate existing processes

• Level 2/3 support for existing workflows

Internal Contacts:

• Steering committee

• Production team (Product-Support)

• Integration team

• All technical teams (Data bases, System, Telecom, Citrix,)

• Development teams based in Geneva

• Support teams (Service Desk and Application Support)

• Service Management teams (Incidents and Problems)

External Contacts:

• Suppliers of external products and/or services

• Technical sponsors of certain banking infrastructure customers

• Technical sponsors of partners of our banking infrastructure customers

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science (Master's degree or equivalent)

• 2 to 10 years in a similar position

• Significant experience on file transfer: implementation of industrial transfer protocols, certificate management. GoAnywhere would be a plus

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, flexible and with good interpersonal skills. Strong team spirit, desire for continuous improvement, proactive.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)

• Residence in Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

Lombard Odier is looking for an HR Business Partner to support its Technology & Operations & Central Function teams based in Switzerland. You co-design HR strategy, anticipate organizational transformations and drive change in direct alignment with Business strategy.

• Leverage HR data and analytics to produce actionable insights for the business

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Risk Manager - Technology & Operations (80-100%)

As part of the Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management team, you will partner with stakeholders across Operations and Technology to identify key risks, coordinate remediation, and strengthen first‑line ownership of controls. You will contribute to the effective oversight of operational, technology and information risks, and ensure transparent and timely reporting to management.

YOUR ROLE

Risk Identification, Assessment & Reporting

• Identify, assess, and report operational risks, including processing, trade order execution, operational taxes, technology, cybersecurity, and information‑related risks across T&O.

• Support the RCSA process and ensure risk assessments remain current, well‑documented, and evidence‑based.

• Manage the T&O incident process, ensuring incidents are recorded, analysed, escalated, and followed through to closure.

Control Environment Oversight

• Contribute to the T&O Risk Assurance Plan through thematic reviews, independent design and operating effectiveness testing of the control environment, and follow‑up of identified gaps.

• Support the ISAE control framework, ensuring required evidence is collected, complete, and audit‑ready.

Remediation & Issue Management

• Drive, coordinate, and track risk remediation activities, ensuring actions are well defined, owned, and delivered on time.

• Monitor and report on the progression of identified issues, ensuring consistent closure, documentation, and controls uplift.

Governance, Assurance & Culture

• Promote a strong risk culture by supporting awareness, training, and constructive challenge across teams.

• Prepare structured and insightful risk reports to the T&O Risk Committee and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 5 years' experience in risk management, internal control, audit, or consulting (e.g., Big Four) with focus on operational or technology‑related risks.

• Solid understanding of operations, IT, cybersecurity, and information risk, ideally within financial services.

• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, detail‑oriented approach.

• Excellent communication skills in English and French, with the ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe

Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Business Risk Manager - Tecnologia e Operazioni (80-100%) Nell'ambito del team Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management, partnerrai con gli stakeholder di Operazioni e Tecnologie per identificare i rischi chiave, coordinare la bonifica e rafforzare la proprietà di prima linea dei controlli. Contribuirai all'effettiva supervisione dei rischi operativi, tecnologici e informativi e garantirai un reporting trasparente e tempestivo alla gestione. Il tuo! Identificazione del rischio, valutazione e reportistica
• Identificare, valutare e segnalare i rischi operativi, tra cui il trattamento, l'esecuzione degli ordini commerciali, le imposte operative, la tecnologia, la sicurezza informatica e i rischi correlati alle informazioni in T&O.
• Sostenere il processo RCSA e garantire che le valutazioni dei rischi rimangano attuali, ben documentate e basate su prove.
• Gestisci il processo di incidente T&O, assicurando che gli incidenti siano registrati, analizzati, escalati e seguiti fino alla chiusura. Controllo dell'ambiente
• Contribuire al T&O Risk Assurance Plan attraverso revisioni tematiche, progettazione indipendente e test di efficacia operativa dell'ambiente di controllo e follow-up di lacune identificate.
• Supporta il quadro di controllo ISAE, assicurando che le prove richieste siano raccolte, complete e pronte all'audit. Remediazione e gestione dei problemi
• Guidare, coordinare e monitorare le attività di bonifica dei rischi, garantire che le azioni siano ben definite, possedute e consegnate in tempo.
• Monitorare e segnalare la progressione dei problemi identificati, assicurando la chiusura coerente, la documentazione e i controlli di sollevamento. Governance, assicurazione e cultura
• Promuovere una forte cultura del rischio sostenendo la consapevolezza, la formazione e la sfida costruttiva tra le squadre.
• Preparare rapporti di rischio strutturati e intuitivi al comitato di rischio T&O e alla gestione senior. Il tuo progetto
• Esperienza minima di 5 anni nella gestione del rischio, nel controllo interno, nell'audit o nella consulenza (ad esempio, Big Four) con particolare attenzione ai rischi operativi o tecnologici.
• Solida comprensione delle operazioni, IT, sicurezza informatica e rischi di informazione, idealmente all'interno dei servizi finanziari.
• Forte mentalità analitica con un approccio strutturato e orientato al dettaglio.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e francese, con la capacità di sfidare gli stakeholder costruttivamente.
• Residente in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Noi crediamo fermamente

jobs.title: IT Security Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Security Engineer (80-100%)

The Security Engineer designs, implements and manages security solutions, ensuring an effective defense against cyber threats or data theft. Responsibilities include threat detection, vulnerability analysis, handling support tickets, and implementing security controls and related solutions (data leakage prevention, vulnerability management, security hardening, public key infrastructure, secrets management, privileged access management and endpoint security). The security engineer will also educate staff on best practices.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, implement, and maintain security solutions

• Conduct and/or contribute to security projects

• Assess and improve the security hardening of enterprise solutions

• Participate in alert and incident response reviews and propose improvement actions

• Propose new security solutions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop security workflows and automate recurring tasks

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, procedures, incident reports, security requirements

• Contribute to enforcing robust security tools and secure coding practices in development

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree computer engineering, security engineering or a relevant field. Master degree is an engineering school is a plus

• Sound experience of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions and best practices

• Strong interest in IT security, continuous learning, secure engineering practices and threat modeling, IT market trends

• Strong knowledge of Azure cloud, Microsoft 365 services and hybrid cloud services

• Excellent command of automation, scripting, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) principles, common software architecture patterns, networking protocols and technologies

• Highly analytical and rigorous, with a solution‑oriented mindset and strong autonomy

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

• Highly versatile and able to adapt to diverse technical contexts

• Fluency in English and French

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. IT Security Engineer (80-100%) Il Security Engineer progetta, implementa e gestisce soluzioni di sicurezza, garantendo una difesa efficace contro le minacce informatiche o il furto di dati. Le responsabilità includono il rilevamento delle minacce, l'analisi delle vulnerabilità, la gestione dei biglietti di supporto, l'implementazione dei controlli di sicurezza e delle relative soluzioni (prevenzione delle perdite di dati, gestione delle vulnerabilità, indurimento della sicurezza, infrastruttura chiave pubblica, gestione dei segreti, gestione privilegiata dell'accesso e sicurezza endpoint). L'ingegnere della sicurezza educa anche il personale sulle migliori pratiche. Il tuo!
• Progettazione, realizzazione e manutenzione di soluzioni di sicurezza
• Condurre e/o contribuire a progetti di sicurezza
• Valutare e migliorare l'indurimento della sicurezza delle soluzioni aziendali
• Partecipare a recensioni di risposta all'avviso e agli incidenti e proporre azioni di miglioramento
• Proporre nuove soluzioni di sicurezza e contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo
• Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di sicurezza e automatizzare le attività ricorrenti
• Mantenere la documentazione completa delle configurazioni del sistema, delle procedure, dei rapporti incidenti, dei requisiti di sicurezza
• Contribuire a rafforzare robusti strumenti di sicurezza e a garantire pratiche di codifica nello sviluppo Il tuo progetto
• Laurea di ingegneria informatica, ingegneria della sicurezza o un campo rilevante. Laurea magistrale è una scuola di ingegneria
• Esperienza sonora delle soluzioni e delle best practice di Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
• Forte interesse per la sicurezza informatica, l'apprendimento continuo, le pratiche ingegneristiche sicure e la modellazione delle minacce, le tendenze del mercato IT
• Forte conoscenza di cloud Azure, servizi Microsoft 365 e servizi cloud ibridi
• Comando eccellente dei principi di automazione, scripting, Infrastructure‐as‐Code (IaC), modelli di architettura software comune, protocolli di rete e tecnologie
• Altamente analitico e rigoroso, con una mentalità orientata alla soluzione e una forte autonomia
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di comunicare con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici
• Altamente versatile e in grado di adattarsi a diversi contesti tecnici
• Fluency in inglese e francese
• Residence in Svizzera o disponibilità a trasferirsi Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e inclusione nel nostro business

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögens- und Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltige Investitionen zu arbeiten. Eine innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden, unser unabhängiger Eigentümer Firm ist eine der besten Bankengruppen der Welt, die in der Nähe von CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten. Lombard Odier ist mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskreten und beratenden Portfolio-Management, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Sorge bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienste und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Manager und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie an andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything“ ist unsere Philosophie – es liegt im Herzen von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker gewachsen, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu denken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. IT-Sicherheitsingenieur (80-100%) Der Security Engineer entwirft, implementiert und verwaltet Sicherheitslösungen, um eine effektive Verteidigung gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen oder Datendiebstahl zu gewährleisten. Zu den Verantwortlichkeiten gehören Bedrohungserkennung, Sicherheitsanalyse, Umgang mit Support-Tickets und die Implementierung von Sicherheitskontrollen und damit verbundenen Lösungen (Daten-Leckverhütung, Sicherheitsverwundbarkeitsmanagement, Sicherheitsverfestigung, öffentliche Schlüsselinfrastruktur, Secrets Management, privilegiertes Zugriffsmanagement und Endpoint Security). Der Sicherheitsingenieur wird auch Mitarbeiter über Best Practices informieren. IHRE ROLLE
• Entwicklung, Implementierung und Aufrechterhaltung von Sicherheitslösungen
• Durchführung und/oder Beitrag zu Sicherheitsprojekten
• Unterstützung und Verbesserung der Sicherheitshärtung von Unternehmenslösungen
• Erwarten Sie Alarm- und Notfallrezensionen und schlagen Sie Verbesserungsmaßnahmen vor
• Neue Sicherheitslösungen auslösen und zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen beitragen
• Entwicklung von Sicherheits-Workflows und Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben
• umfassende Dokumentation von Systemkonfigurationen, Verfahren, Zwischenberichte, Sicherheitsanforderungen
• Beitrag zur Durchsetzung von robusten Sicherheitswerkzeugen und zur sicheren Kodierungspraxis in der Entwicklung IHRE PROFILE
• Bachelor-Abschluss Computertechnik, Sicherheitstechnik oder ein relevantes Feld. Master-Abschluss ist eine Ingenieurschule ein Plus
• Klangerlebnis von Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Lösungen und Best Practices
• Starkes Interesse an IT-Sicherheit, kontinuierliches Lernen, sichere Engineering-Praktiken und Bedrohungsmodellierung, IT-Markttrends
• Starkes Wissen über Azure Cloud, Microsoft 365 Services und Hybrid Cloud Services
• Hervorragender Befehl von Automatisierung, Skripting, Infrastructure‐as‐Code (IaC) Prinzipien, gemeinsamen Softwarearchitekturmustern, Netzwerkprotokollen und Technologien
• Hochanalytisch und streng, mit einer lösungsorientierten Denkweise und starker Autonomie
• Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, sowohl mit technischen als auch nichttechnischen Akteuren zu kommunizieren
• Sehr vielseitig und in der Lage, sich an unterschiedliche technische Zusammenhänge anzupassen
• Fluency auf Englisch und Französisch
• Aufenthalt in der Schweiz oder Verlagerungsbereitschaft Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert. Exzellenz treibt uns dazu, das Beste zu sein, während Innovation unseren Fortschritt vorantreibt. Respekt unterstützt jede Interaktion und Integrität prägt unsere Handlungen. Gemeinsam sind wir ein Team, vereint in der Betreuung unserer Kunden mit unerschütterlicher Hingabe. Als verantwortungsbewusster und unterstützender Arbeitgeber fördern wir ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für unsere Mitarbeiter und Kandidaten. Diversity, Equity und Inclusion sind in den Stoff unserer Maison’s DNA gewebt, und wir bemühen uns, sicherzustellen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter ihre persönlichen und beruflichen Bestrebungen erfüllen können, indem wir interne Mobilität und individuelle Upskilling-Programme fördern. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass das Bauen von Diverse Teams zu unseren Erfolgen beiträgt und wir darauf aktiv Diversity, Equity und Inclusion in unser Geschäft einbetten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Ingénieur en sécurité des TI (80-100%) L'ingénieur de sécurité conçoit, met en œuvre et gère des solutions de sécurité, assurant une défense efficace contre les cybermenaces ou le vol de données. Les responsabilités comprennent la détection des menaces, l'analyse de la vulnérabilité, le traitement des tickets de soutien et la mise en place de contrôles de sécurité et de solutions connexes (prévention des fuites de données, gestion de la vulnérabilité, durcissement de la sécurité, infrastructure à clé publique, gestion des secrets, gestion des accès privilégiés et sécurité des terminaux). L'ingénieur en sécurité informera également le personnel des pratiques exemplaires. Votre rôle
• Conception, mise en œuvre et maintien de solutions de sécurité
• Mener des projets de sécurité ou y contribuer;
• Évaluer et améliorer le durcissement de la sécurité des solutions d'entreprise
• Participer aux examens d'alerte et d'intervention en cas d'incident et proposer des mesures d'amélioration
• Proposer de nouvelles solutions de sécurité et contribuer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue
• Développer les workflows de sécurité et automatiser les tâches récurrentes
• Tenir à jour une documentation complète sur les configurations, les procédures, les rapports d'incident et les exigences en matière de sécurité;
• Contribuer à l'application d'outils de sécurité robustes et de pratiques de codage sécurisées dans le développement VOTRE PROFIL
• Baccalauréat en génie informatique, en génie de la sécurité ou dans un domaine pertinent. Maîtrise est une école d'ingénieur est un plus
• Bonne expérience des solutions et des meilleures pratiques de prévention des pertes de données
• Fort intérêt pour la sécurité informatique, l'apprentissage continu, les pratiques d'ingénierie sécurisées et la modélisation des menaces, les tendances du marché informatique
• Forte connaissance du cloud Azure, des services Microsoft 365 et des services cloud hybrides
• Excellente maîtrise de l'automatisation, du script, des principes Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), des schémas d'architecture de logiciels communs, des protocoles de réseautage et des technologies
• Très analytique et rigoureux, avec une mentalité orientée vers la solution et une forte autonomie
• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de communiquer avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques
• Très polyvalent et capable de s'adapter à divers contextes techniques
• Connaissance de l'anglais et du français
• Résidence en Suisse ou volonté de déménager L'ADN de la Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente nos progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction, et l'intégrité façonne nos actions. Ensemble, nous sommes une équipe, unie pour servir nos clients avec un dévouement inébranlable. En tant qu'employeur responsable et solidaire, nous favorisons un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour nos employés et nos candidats. Diversité, équité et inclusion sont tissés dans le tissu de notre ADN Maison, et nous nous efforçons de faire en sorte que nos employés puissent réaliser leurs aspirations personnelles et professionnelles en encourageant la mobilité interne et les programmes de perfectionnement individuel. Nous croyons fermement que la création d'équipes diversifiées contribue à nos réussites et pour y parvenir, nous intégrons activement la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion dans nos activités
